title: Uses Permitted As-of-Right

blocks.html: The following special permits shall not apply. In lieu thereof, such uses shall be permitted as-of-right:
blocks.plainText: The following special permits shall not apply. In lieu thereof, such uses shall be permitted as-of-right:

blocks.html: Section 74-182          (Arenas, Auditoriums, Stadiums or Trade Expositions) shall not apply for trade expositions with a capacity in excess of 2,500 persons, provided that the facility has a floor area of no more than 400,000 square feet;

blocks.html: Section 73-462          (In Commercial or Manufacturing Districts) shall not apply for group parking facilities exceeding 225 spaces, provided such facilities comply with the regulations set forth in Section 124-50 (OFF-STREET PARKING REGULATIONS), inclusive.
